description.en: Gentle young woman: everyday Chinese, the Studio's default.
description.zh: 温柔的青年女声，日常中文，Studio 的默认音色。

description.en: Clear young man with a light Beijing lilt.
description.zh: 清朗的青年男声，带一点京腔。

description.en: A kind grandmother from Guilin, chatting in the yard.
description.zh: 桂林的慈祥奶奶，在院子里聊家常。

persona: 一位七十多岁的桂林老奶奶，嗓音温暖、略微沙哑，说普通话时带一点桂林口音，语气慈祥，像在院子里跟孙子聊家常。
sample: 老早老早以前，月亮上住着一只老打喷嚏的兔子。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: An easygoing Sichuan uncle chatting over tea.
description.zh: 在茶馆摆龙门阵的四川大叔。

persona: 一位五十岁左右的成都大叔，在茶馆里摆龙门阵，说话带浓浓的四川口音，嗓音亮、爱笑，语气松弛又幽默。
sample: 坐嘛，喝口茶。莫急，下午还长得很。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A clear, confident Mandarin news anchor.
description.zh: 清亮沉稳的普通话新闻主播。

persona: 一位三十岁左右的女主播，声音清亮干净，吐字清晰，语气沉稳自信，像在演播室外跟同事聊今天的新闻。
sample: 各位观众，晚上好。下面是今晚的主要内容。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A soft, calm woman for bedtime stories.
description.zh: 轻柔沉静的女声，适合睡前故事。

persona: 一位四十多岁的女性，声音轻柔温暖，语气沉静，像在昏黄的台灯下讲睡前故事。
sample: 闭上眼睛吧。灯笼还亮着，故事还没讲完呢。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A low, husky man who has been around.
description.zh: 低沉沙哑、见过世面的中年男人。

persona: 一位四十五岁左右的中年男人，嗓音低沉、带点沙哑，说话干脆、有江湖气，像在路边小饭馆跟老朋友讲以前跑长途的经历。
sample: 那条路我跑了十几年，哪个弯道有坑，我闭着眼都知道。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A warm, sincere man for brands and family stories.
description.zh: 温暖真诚的中年男声，适合品牌和家庭故事。

persona: 一位四十岁左右的男人，嗓音温暖厚实，语气真诚亲切，像周末在家跟家人商量出去玩的计划。
sample: 每个周末，我们都会留一个下午，什么也不做，就陪着家里人。
ref: 上周末我去爬山，本来以为一个小时就能到顶，结果走了快三个小时！你猜怎么着？山顶的风景美得不得了，一点都不后悔。

description.zh: 明亮有活力的年轻女声。

persona: 一位二十三四岁的年轻女生，声音明亮清脆、有活力，语气果断又真诚，像在跟好朋友讲自己刚做成的一件事。
sample: 你猜怎么着？那个方案最后真的通过了，我到现在都不敢相信。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A low, quiet young man for suspense and true stories.
description.zh: 低沉克制的青年男声，适合悬疑和纪实故事。

persona: 一位三十岁左右的男人，嗓音低沉、带一点气声，语气克制冷静，像深夜跟朋友讲一桩旧案子的来龙去脉。
sample: 深夜，整栋楼只有一扇窗户还亮着灯。
ref: 上周末我去爬山，本来以为一个小时就能到顶，结果走了快三个小时！你猜怎么着？山顶的风景美得不得了，一点都不后悔。

description.en: A calm, clear guide for tours and explainers.
description.zh: 沉稳清晰的讲解员，适合导览和讲解。

persona: 一位四十岁左右的女讲解员，声音温和清晰、吐字干净，语气沉稳专业，像在展厅里跟一小群参观者边走边聊。
sample: 请仔细看这层釉面，这些细小的开片是有意烧出来的。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A very low, smooth man with quiet menace.
description.zh: 极低沉、圆滑，带着克制的威胁感。

persona: 一位五十岁左右的男人，嗓音很低、圆滑有磁性，语气从容，带着克制的威胁感，像在昏暗的书房里跟对手摊牌。
sample: 地图你留着吧，它通向哪里，我早就知道了。
ref: 早上出门才发现忘了带伞，雨一下子就大了。我只好躲进旁边的书店，没想到还淘到一本找了好久的旧书，真是意外的收获！

description.en: A loud, cheerful friend from Northeast China.
description.zh: 嗓门大、热情爽快的东北小伙。

persona: 一位二十七八岁的东北小伙，嗓门大、性子直，说话带东北口音，热情爽快，像在饭桌上招呼朋友。
sample: 哎，你搁那儿杵着干啥呢？过来吃饭，管够！
ref: 昨天晚上楼下那家面馆排了好长的队，我也好奇地排了一会儿。牛肉面一端上来，香得不行！你下次要不要一起去尝尝？

description.en: A kind old man with a deep, mellow voice.
description.zh: 嗓音醇厚、和蔼的老爷爷。

persona: 一位七十岁左右的老爷爷，嗓音低沉醇厚、略带沙哑，语气和蔼，像在院子里跟邻居拉家常。
sample: 这棵树是你爸出生那年我种的，它熬过了三场大风。
ref: 上周末我去爬山，本来以为一个小时就能到顶，结果走了快三个小时！你猜怎么着？山顶的风景美得不得了，一点都不后悔。

description.en: Warm American woman: English's default voice.
description.zh: 温暖的美式女声，英文的默认音色。
清晰从容的美式女声。
轻快亲切的美式女声。
沉稳的美式男声。
成熟的英式男声。
圆润随和的美式电台主持。

persona: A man around thirty with a smooth, warm baritone and an easygoing American voice, like a late-night radio host chatting with a caller.
sample: It's a quarter past midnight, the city's finally quiet, and you're still up. Same here.
ref: I've been learning to bake bread, and my first loaf was as hard as a rock. My brother tried to cut it and the knife just bounced off! The third one, though, came out perfect.

description.en: A serious, resonant voice for documentaries.
description.zh: 严肃浑厚的纪录片解说。

persona: A man in his fifties with a low, resonant American voice, serious and measured, like a historian telling a friend about a discovery in the archives over dinner.
sample: The archive had been sealed for ninety years. What it contained changed the story.
ref: This morning I missed my bus by about ten seconds. I was just standing there, coffee in hand, watching it pull away! Then a friend drove past and gave me a ride. How lucky is that?

description.zh: 温暖健谈的澳洲播客主持。

persona: An Australian woman in her forties with a warm, friendly voice and an easy laugh, chatting with a neighbour across the kitchen table.
sample: Pull up a chair. This week we tried to grow tomatoes on a balcony, and it went badly.
ref: Last weekend I finally tried that little noodle place around the corner. The line went all the way down the street! Was it worth it? Honestly, yes. I'm already planning to go back on Friday.

description.zh: 沉稳好奇的英式访谈主持。

persona: A British woman in her late forties with a calm, clear voice, curious and attentive, like a radio interviewer talking with a guest before the show.
sample: So tell me, when did you first realise this was going to be more than a hobby?
ref: This morning I missed my bus by about ten seconds. I was just standing there, coffee in hand, watching it pull away! Then a friend drove past and gave me a ride. How lucky is that?

description.zh: 低沉有气势的预告片配音。

persona: A deep, resonant man in his fifties with a big chest voice, a film-trailer narrator who is talking to a friend about a movie he loves, intense but relaxed.
sample: In a world where every clock has stopped, one girl still hears ticking.
ref: Last weekend I finally tried that little noodle place around the corner. The line went all the way down the street! Was it worth it? Honestly, yes. I'm already planning to go back on Friday.

description.zh: 温暖睿智的英式老奶奶。

persona: A British woman in her seventies with a warm, slightly husky voice, kind and wise, like a grandmother giving advice over a cup of tea.
sample: You don't have to have it all figured out, dear. Nobody does. Just take the next step.
ref: I've been learning to bake bread, and my first loaf was as hard as a rock. My brother tried to cut it and the knife just bounced off! The third one, though, came out perfect.

description.en: A weathered old man who tells sea tales.
description.zh: 讲海上故事的老人，粗粝而温暖。

persona: A weathered British man in his seventies, low and raspy but warm, telling a friend a story by the fire, relaxed and a little amused.
sample: Forty winters I kept that light. Only once did it go dark, and I'll tell you why.
ref: This morning I missed my bus by about ten seconds. I was just standing there, coffee in hand, watching it pull away! Then a friend drove past and gave me a ride. How lucky is that?

description.zh: 阳光开朗的小男孩。

persona: A cheerful little boy, about eight, with a bright, clear American voice, excitedly telling his family about his day at school.
sample: Today I'm going to grow the biggest sunflower in the whole world!
ref: Grandma has a garden full of tomatoes. I picked the biggest one and it was so sweet! Have you ever eaten a tomato right off the plant? It's way better than the ones from the shop.

description.en: A low, velvety narrator for romance and drama.
description.zh: 低沉丝滑的女声，适合言情与剧情小说。

persona: A young American woman around thirty with a smooth, low, velvety voice, warm and intimate, chatting with a friend late at night.
sample: She read the letter twice, then folded it into the smallest square she could.
ref: Last weekend I finally tried that little noodle place around the corner. The line went all the way down the street! Was it worth it? Honestly, yes. I'm already planning to go back on Friday.

description.zh: 清晰的西班牙语女声。
清晰的法语女声。
清晰的意大利语女声。
清晰的巴西葡萄牙语女声。

description.en: A warm Russian grandfather telling folk tales.
description.zh: 讲民间故事的俄语老爷爷，低沉温暖。

persona: A Russian man in his sixties with a low, warm voice, speaking Russian, telling his grandchildren a folk tale by the stove.
sample: Глубоко в лесу, где снег никогда не тает до конца, жил хитрый заяц.
ref: В прошлые выходные мы поднялись на холм за городом. Казалось, это займёт час, а получилось почти три! Зато вид сверху был просто потрясающий. Ты там когда-нибудь был?

description.zh: 有磁性的韩语深夜电台 DJ。

persona: A Korean man around thirty with a low, smooth voice, speaking Korean, like a late-night radio DJ chatting softly with his listeners.
sample: 밤이 깊었어요. 거리는 텅 비었고, 이 노래는 당신을 위한 거예요.
ref: 지난 주말에 친구랑 산에 올라갔는데, 한 시간이면 될 줄 알았거든요. 그런데 거의 세 시간이나 걸렸어요! 그래도 정상에서 본 경치가 정말 멋져서 하나도 후회 안 했어요.

description.zh: 亲切的西班牙语会话伙伴。

persona: A friendly Spanish man in his late twenties with a clear, bright voice, speaking Spanish, chatting with a friend over coffee.
sample: Vamos a practicar cómo pedir un café. ¿Listo? Repite conmigo.
ref: Anoche había una cola enorme delante del restaurante de fideos de la esquina. Me puse a esperar por curiosidad, ¡y valió muchísimo la pena! ¿Quieres venir conmigo la próxima vez?

description.zh: 沉稳的德语旁白。

persona: A warm, calm German man in his fifties with a deep voice, speaking German, chatting with a friend in the evening.
sample: Das Dorf lag still unter dem Schnee, und nur das Fenster der Bäckerei war erleuchtet.
ref: Letztes Wochenende sind wir auf den Berg hinter der Stadt gestiegen. Ich dachte, das dauert eine Stunde, aber es waren fast drei! Die Aussicht oben war trotzdem fantastisch. Warst du schon mal dort oben?

description.zh: 明亮亲切的日语主持。

persona: A Japanese woman in her twenties with a sweet, bright voice, speaking Japanese, chatting cheerfully with a friend on a train platform.
sample: 次の電車は海辺行きです。どうぞ景色をお楽しみください。
ref: 朝、家を出てから傘を忘れたことに気づきました。急に雨が強くなったので近くの本屋に入ったら、ずっと探していた古い本が見つかったんです。運がいいでしょう？
